page.layout: Left printed page: one column of verse with a centred heading above a verse block; no running head, no page number. Right printed page (cut at the scan edge): fragments of a column of text and marginal references at the right edge, mostly illegible.

main_text.l: Mens nescit reprimi, nec mare turgidum s:
Sic mens claustra fugit, sic cupit exitus.
Mensuras: numerosq; suos hac protulit aetas,
Hæc aetas certa protulit arte sonos:
Ast inculta, iacet diuina scientia moles,
Hanc bene digestam reddit cum fœnore
Fenner viue diu, laudes urbis & orbis habes.
Right page fragments (partly illegible, cut at the edge): pa / pl / & / pe / Ia / 1r / 26 / (f) / 32 / in / cō / glo.

page.notes: The right printed page is cut off by the scan edge; only the fragments at its left edge are visible and are given only as far as they can be read. Verse lines are set in italic. The line "Ogdoas G. A." is a centred title line. The line "Mensuras: numerosq; suos" has a superscript mark over the q; "Qua" is partly struck through by an underline. Doubtful: "Qua" in the second-to-last verse line may be "Quæ"; the marked "q" in "numerosq;" is read as q;.
